package private

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	httpmw "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/middleware"
)

// NewRouter registers internal-only routes.
func NewRouter(
	taskHandler *handlers.TaskHandler,
	lessonHandler *handlers.LessonHandler,
	knowledgeIdentityHandler *handlers.KnowledgeIdentityHandler,
	generatedCourseHandler *handlers.GeneratedCourseHandler,
	token string,
	learningPlannerToken string,
	diagnosticCatalogToken string,
) chi.Router {
	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Group(func(trusted chi.Router) {
		trusted.Use(httpmw.RequireInternalToken(token))
		if lessonHandler != nil {
			trusted.Get("/lesson/get-internal-lesson/{lessonID}", lessonHandler.GetInternalLesson)
			trusted.Post("/lessons/{lessonID}/revision", lessonHandler.ResolveRevision)
			trusted.Get("/lesson-revisions/{revisionID}", lessonHandler.GetRevision)
			trusted.Get("/lesson/{lessonID}/teacher-context", lessonHandler.GetTeacherContext)
		}
		if knowledgeIdentityHandler != nil {
			trusted.Post("/course/resolve-lesson-bindings", knowledgeIdentityHandler.ResolveCourseLessonBindings)
		}
		if taskHandler != nil {
			trusted.Get("/task/get-internal-task/{taskID}", taskHandler.GetInternalTask)
			trusted.Get("/task/get-internal-course-structure/{courseID}", taskHandler.GetInternalCourseStructure)
			trusted.Get("/course/get-internal-course-structure/{courseID}", taskHandler.GetInternalCourseStructure)
			trusted.Get("/course-progress/lessons", taskHandler.GetInternalCompletedLessons)
		}
	})
	if learningPlannerToken != "" {
		planner := r.With(httpmw.RequireInternalToken(learningPlannerToken))
		if generatedCourseHandler != nil {
			planner.Post("/generated-courses", generatedCourseHandler.EnsureCourse)
		}
	}
	if diagnosticCatalogToken != "" && taskHandler != nil {
		r.With(httpmw.RequireInternalToken(diagnosticCatalogToken)).Get(
			"/course/get-internal-diagnostic-assessments/{courseID}", taskHandler.GetInternalDiagnosticAssessments,
		)
	}
	return r
}
